# Zork I: The Great Underground Empire — full 350/350 walkthrough fixture
# (wayfinder ticket #30). One command per line; # lines are comments.
#
# Game:   zork1
# Seed:   12  (the fixture is the (script, seed) pair; replay with
#         `go run ./internal/actions/capture zork1 12 < this-file`)
# Source: converted from Jacob Gunness's Zork I solution (23 March 1990),
#         IF Archive: if-archive/infocom/hints/solutions/zorkI.step2,
#         restructured so the thief is killed late (at score 234) instead of
#         early, with per-seed combat and theft adjustments (see comments).
# Final:  score 350 of 350, 374 moves, rank Master Adventurer; the last turn
#         enters the stone barrow and the game halts on the Zork II teaser.
#
